title: A Crash Course on Boundaries
coreMove: Treat dread, resentment, avoidance, and anger as boundary signals; name the limit clearly, then follow through on your own access, time, topic, or participation.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need solitude without cutting off friendly contact
exampleSpecs.stakes: protect daily mental health while preserving goodwill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist protects a weekday walk from an elderly neighbor while offering Saturday morning as limited connection

exampleSpecs.domain: family dinner before a mother visit
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who treat anticipatory anxiety as overreaction
exampleSpecs.stakes: use dread to name the topic before the first comment lands
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist names dread before a mother visit involving twenty pounds and recurring weight comments

exampleSpecs.domain: family scheduling after a strained visit
exampleSpecs.audience: people who avoid contact instead of naming the limit
exampleSpecs.stakes: restore contact by separating family love from parenting debate
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist treats avoided invitations from parents as a clue that co-parenting with a new husband needs a spoken limit

exampleSpecs.audience: people who overexplain a small limit
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep the sentence clear instead of defending the need
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist rehearses a weekday walk boundary with an elderly neighbor and keeps Saturday morning as a specific alternative

exampleSpecs.domain: family text thread before a visit
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who wait for the first hurtful comment
exampleSpecs.stakes: respond to the signal before resentment needs anger
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist uses a photo text before a mother visit to prepare a boundary around twenty pounds and weight comments

exampleSpecs.domain: family postmortem after a tense meal
exampleSpecs.audience: people who set a limit but do not hold it
exampleSpecs.stakes: show that follow-through protects the next visit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist reviews a visit where parents tested the co-parenting limit and the new husband watched the follow-through
